name: Kids
overview: Scripture reveals that children are a blessing from God, entrusted to parents to raise wisely and with loving discipline, as seen in the call to be fruitful and multiply (Genesis 1:28) and the wisdom of a son bringing joy to his father (Proverbs 10:1). Jesus Himself welcomed children, emphasizing their special place in the kingdom of God (Matthew 19:14; Luke 18:16), while the vision of streets filled with boys and girls at play in Zechariah 8:5 reflects the joy and value of children within the community. This study explores the biblical principles of nurturing and guiding children, including the role of mothers in caring for their kids at home.
